definitions.explanation: A person who has achieved notable success, typically in business, career, or life goals. Often implies wealth or social status.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はビジネスの{成功者|せいこうしゃ}だ。
{成功者|せいこうしゃ}に{共通|きょうつう}する{習慣|しゅうかん}がある。
examples.english: There are habits common to successful people.

examples.japanese: {成功者|せいこうしゃ}の{多|おお}くは、{若|わか}いころに{大|おお}きな{失敗|しっぱい}を{経験|けいけん}している。
examples.english: Many successful people experienced major failures when they were young.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {成功|せいこう} (success) and {者|しゃ} (person). Commonly used in self-help books, business articles, and motivational contexts. The word often implies financial or career success rather than personal fulfillment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成功者|せいこうしゃ}の{秘訣|ひけつ}: secrets of successful people
- {成功者|せいこうしゃ}に{学|まな}ぶ: to learn from successful people
- {成功者|せいこうしゃ}の{考|かんが}え{方|かた}: the way successful people think
- {人生|じんせい}の{成功者|せいこうしゃ}: a person successful in life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}: winner (in life/society) — more colloquial and sometimes used cynically
- {実業家|じつぎょうか}: businessperson; entrepreneur — focuses on the business role, not the success itself
- {立志伝中|りっしでんちゅう}の{人|ひと}: self-made person — emphasizes rising from humble origins through determination
